scope: Presentation and visual review of an existing movie. No source-field array decoding, numerical feature calculation, simulation, automatic tracker or extra evaluator.

original_run_metadata.public_copy_note: Publisher removes local filesystem prefixes; original source metadata hash remains recorded here.

scientific_array.verification: Not newly read or decoded; protocol digest declaration only.

frozen_selection.rank_meaning: 1-based quality order in this frame only, not an identity label
frozen_selection.feature: A separate internal hooked/curled A1 stripe with an interior low-A1 bay, lying inside a closed outer A1 boundary and separated from it by an A0-rich band. A0 is blue and A1 orange in the legacy composite; the existing native movie displays A0 cyan and A1 pale cream in separate fixed-scale panels.
frozen_selection.allowed_feature_changes: Rotation, smooth deformation, motion and intensity variation may occur; exact outline and pixels need not be identical. The nested boundary/intermediate band/internal curled-stripe organization must remain discernible.

criteria.after_first_loss_or_ambiguity: Continue reporting all remaining saved samples as requested, but do not restart the original identity or choose another survivor. Later similar appearance cannot repair earlier failure.
criteria.ambiguity: Resolution, changing surroundings, alternative matching or possible split/merge/replacement prevents an unambiguous visual continuation or feature judgment. Record the first affected interval; do not silently join the track across it.
criteria.boundary_loss: A visible disappearance, opening that destroys the enclosure, or connection/merger that prevents separating the selected individual.
criteria.failure_bracket: Last supported sample and first contradicted/ambiguous sample; unseen between-sample events remain unobserved.
criteria.feature_loss: The internal curled stripe/bay and intermediate A0 region cease to be distinguishable as the frozen nested organization, even if a boundary or simple activity blob remains.
criteria.identity_supported: The selected enclosure remains visually identifiable from one retained observation to the next by its position, boundary and surrounding pattern; no visible loss, split, merge or competing continuation. This is sampled apparent identity, not material continuity.

frozen_selection.selection_bias: Selected retrospective review, not blinded confirmation. P7 snapshots at t25,250,750 were inspected before this selection; the final appearance influenced selection of a promising example. No prevalence or held-out success claim.

review_window.note: Legacy detector used every tenth saved state (25-unit cadence). The existing native movie contains301 states at2.5-unit cadence; this review includes all201 subsequent available states, not just21 detector states.

presentation.method: Lossless PNG extraction from the existing native MP4; fixed pixel panels/crops, nearest-neighbor detail enlargement, labeled contact sheets. No scientific arrays, metrics or automated identity tracking.
presentation.generation_record_note: Generated before inspection; completion and judgments are recorded separately in visual-observations.json.

overview.method: Six evenly spaced, already-reviewed observations. Fixed full-domain panels, fixed detail crops enlarged 2x by nearest-neighbor, yellow fixed-window rectangles only where visual identity is supported. No field decoding or numerical feature calculation.
